svg.aria-label: Overview: Networking with a Cisco ISR 4331, two Catalyst 3850 switches, 4 VLANs and a 20G core uplink. Servers and storage with a Dell R720 running Proxmox, six VMs in an Active Directory domain and a UniFi UNAS Pro. Security with an OPNsense firewall and Suricata IDS, Wazuh and Splunk Free, and isolated guest Wi-Fi.
svg.title: What's inside
